testPathGlob.description: Only the test paths matching the glob pattern will be executed.

testNameGlob.description: Only the test names matching the glob pattern will be executed.

requirement.description:
This field is used to further filter out any matching test suites whose {@link requirementForPath}'s corresponding
{@link Action.Requirement#enginesForTest} cannot run this Action.Requirement.
E.g. if "py-py4j-ml" is specified as the requirement and the test glob is /somePkg/test/py-ml/test_foo.py, we will only
run the test in the `Action.Engine` `py-ml-server-py4j`. Otherwise, this test would have run against `Action.Engines`
`py-ml-client-ipython` and `py-ml-server-py4j`.

includeDependencies.description: If true, execute tests from the current package and all its dependency packages.

endpoint.description: The endpoint of the C3 server to connect to, in the case the test requires a remote server.
